status.main_product: Smart Building, Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS), IoT and Smart Digital Twin (SDT) solutions
status.scope_reason: The company provides its own Smart Digital Twin (SDT) platform alongside IoT and infrastructure automation for smart cities, campuses, and municipal systems.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website, Four Corners Technologies offers its 4CT Smart Digital Twin (SDT) platform to provide connected infrastructure and automated facility management for smart cities and enterprise campuses.

claims.claim: The company reports that its proprietary 4BAT platform powers its flagship 4CT Smart Digital Twin (SDT) and 4CT Smart Digital Build (SDB) software to integrate HVAC, lighting, and metering data with 3D visualizations for intelligent facility management, as stated on the Four Corners Technology Website.

A former employee's project portfolio indicates the company developed customized BMS applications and facility monitoring software for Singapore Airport Terminal Services (SATS) and Google's head offices in Bangalore and Hyderabad, according to Aadith Suresh's Professional Profile.

The company reports that its flagship platform, Smart Digital Twin (SDT), integrates IoT sensor feeds with building systems such as HVAC, lighting, and metering to enable real-time tracking of parameters like temperature, humidity, power, and air quality alongside 3D visualizations.

The company reports that its artificial intelligence models perform predictive analytics, fault detection, energy forecasting, and continuous operational optimization, with implementations deployed at client facilities such as Adani Airports.

The company reports that its digital twin platform incorporates predictive failure modeling with auto-scheduling capabilities, as outlined in its presentation overview for the Niagara Forum APAC 2025.
Four Corners Technologies reports that it was recognized as the winner of the ET Business Award 2025 for Excellence in Automation Technologies with AI for Commercial Buildings.
claims.source: Four Corners Technologies Pvt. Ltd. LinkedIn Post & The Economic Times

claims.claim: Four Corners Technologies announced a strategic reseller partnership in September 2024 with Lynxspring to incorporate Lynxspring's controller portfolio to add value to 4CT's evolving Building AI innovations.
claims.source: Lynxspring Press Release via EINPresswire / AV Today Magazine

claims.claim: The company reports delivering smart digital twin and connected infrastructure solutions that support government facilities, airports, aviation facilities, smart cities, and municipal infrastructure integrating unified facility management.
claims.note: government facilities, airports, aviation facilities, smart cities, and municipal infrastructure integrating unified facility management

claims.claim: The company reported a total revenue of ₹11.71 Cr for the financial year ending on March 31, 2025, representing a decline of 10% compared to the previous financial year, as disclosed in its corporate financial filings registered with the Registrar of Companies (ROC) Bangalore.
claims.source: Registrar of Companies (ROC) Bangalore filings via TheCompanyCheck

claims.claim: Four Corners Technologies deployed its technology framework to implement enterprise-scale Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS), IoT, and energy optimization solutions across mission-critical environments at Adani Airports, AstraZeneca R&D facilities, and Google India campuses (Source: Tridium Niagara Forum APAC Agenda).
claims.source: Tridium Niagara Forum APAC Presentation Replay Agenda

claims.claim: Four Corners Technologies (4CT) announced a strategic reseller partnership designating it as the exclusive reseller partner for Lynxspring's full range of IoT and smart building technologies, products, and solutions in India, including the Niagara Framework JENEsys and JENEsys Edge product portfolios.
claims.source: AV Today Magazine and EIN Presswire press release (September 24, 2024)

claims.claim: Four Corners Technologies was recognized by The Economic Times with the ET Business Award 2025 for "Excellence in Automation Technologies with AI for Commercial Buildings," honoring its proprietary flagship platforms.
claims.source: The Economic Times (via official announcement by Four Corners Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)

claims.claim: Four Corners Technologies was announced in September 2024 as the exclusive reseller partner in India for Lynxspring's full range of hardware and software platforms to enhance its smart digital twin and building automation deployment.
claims.source: EIN Presswire and Lynxspring Press Release Archive (September 2024)
